description: Rothco’s Operators Tactical Chest Rig is designed as a lightweight and efficient alternative to traditional plate carrier vests. Constructed from durable 600D polyester, with the MultiCam version made from 1000D Cordura nylon, this chest rig is built for longevity and performance. The rig features 4 rows of MOLLE webbing, allowing for customizable attachment of accessories and gear. Included are 3 removable open-top kangaroo double rifle mag pouches, each equipped with drain holes for functionality in all conditions. Please note, pictured mags not included. The fully adjustable shoulder straps accommodate most users and include 3 rows of MOLLE and D-rings for integrating hydration systems. For added comfort, the shoulder straps feature ventilated mesh padding. The inner pocket with a hook & loop patch is perfect for pistol holsters, while 2 swivel push-button release buckles, 2 side release buckles, and a quick-release waist cinch strap ensure easy mounting and removal. Additionally, the chest rig includes an interior document pocket with a hook & loop closure and a padded mesh pocket measuring 9 inch x 6 inch with a hook & loop closure for secure storage.
